budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant proposed a bond figure to cover finishing stormwater seeding/regrading work; the town's peer-review engineer recommended a higher figure that builds in a 30% escalator for cost overruns.

budget_items.topic: Storm water bond approved, 7-Eleven Mass Ave
budget_items.what_was_said: The board voted to set the bond amount as a cash bond, not to be released until vegetation is established and the site meets requirements after November 1, 2026.

budget_items.topic: Tax title law change - appraisal obligation
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair explained that under a recent change to tax title law, the town must now pay the former owner the difference between what is owed and the appraised value, rather than keeping the full property as before.

budget_items.topic: Hollis Road tax-title properties, size and suitability
budget_items.what_was_said: Two town-acquired tax-title properties on Hollis Road were discussed for possible municipal or senior-housing use; one was described as a topographically difficult site with wetlands issues, the other as flatter and possibly suitable if the lien is close to appraised value.
A board member noted the Capital Planning Committee would meet to make last-minute changes because it has been an unusually challenging budget year; no figures were given.

The storm water task force reported working on cost estimates and a case for funding stormwater work through a dedicated utility or enterprise fund rather than the general budget, ahead of public outreach.

decisions.decision: Director will circulate sample bylaws in stages (senior housing, then cluster housing, then inclusionary zoning) with board feedback due by end of June and drafts targeted for July.
Board members will informally share summer travel/quorum plans with each other rather than discussing scheduling in public session.
The ANR application for Zero Reservoir Road stays open and will not be substantively discussed tonight unless the storm water permit matter is resolved.
Applicant's engineer for 60 Cross Road/30 Pine Grove asked to submit a phasing plan and progress-based construction schedule so storm water compliance can be managed lot by lot.
Master plan update discussion is postponed to the next meeting after the chair did not circulate materials in time.

Director will obtain lien amounts for both Hollis Road tax-title properties and place the matter on the May 11 agenda; board cannot vote tonight since it was not on the agenda, and will inform the Select Board a vote will come after their May 12 meeting.
Confirmed no second Planning Board meeting in May (Memorial Day conflict); two meetings scheduled in June.

minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Planning Board held storm water permit hearings for Zero Reservoir Road, 60 Cross Road/30 Pine Grove/68 Cross Road, and 222 West Townsend Road, approving the Zero Reservoir Road permit and continuing the others to May 11. what_happened.line: The board could not vote on whether the town should keep two tax-foreclosed Hollis Road properties, pushing the decision to May 11.
Storm water permit hearings for two other developments were continued to May 11 pending further review.
The board approved a storm water permit for the Zero Reservoir Road development after adding a requirement for town counsel to review the HOA document.
After residents raised concerns about erosion and incomplete hydroseeding, the board set a cash bond for stabilization work at 7-Eleven Mass Ave, not releasable before November 1, 2026.

The chair noted a change in state tax title law now requires the town to pay a foreclosed owner the difference between what was owed and the property's appraised value, rather than keeping the full property.

why_it_matters: Whether the town keeps or disposes of the Hollis Road properties affects options like municipal or senior housing use, and the new tax title law changes what the town owes a former owner either way.
Residents near the 60 Cross Road and 222 West Townsend Road sites raised drainage and erosion concerns that remain unresolved until the May 11 hearing.
The bond set at 7-Eleven Mass Ave is meant to ensure erosion and hydroseeding work gets finished, with the money held until vegetation is established.
watch_next: May 11, 2026 Planning Board meeting: vote on the Hollis Road tax-title properties and continued storm water permit hearings (60 Cross Road, 222 West Townsend Road, 860 New West Townsend Road)
